after.target_text: Licen i un mawr,… os gwelwch yn dda. Gyda llaeth ceirch… os yw e 'da chi.

ops.speaker: Barista
ops.english: Of course. Would you like to sit-in or takeaway?
ops.from: Wrth gwrs. Ydych chi moyn eistedd i mewn… neu fynd â fe mas?
ops.note: "take it away" → "takeaway": "mas" comes off, leaving the same shape as the Northern corpus's "neu fynd â fo?".

after.target_text: Wrth gwrs. Ydych chi moyn eistedd i mewn… neu fynd â fe?

ops.speaker: Customer 1
ops.english: I'd like takeaway, please.
ops.from: Licen i fynd â fe mas,… os gwelwch yn dda.
ops.note: same edit as the line above, kept in step with it.

after.target_text: Licen i fynd â fe,… os gwelwch yn dda.

ops.speaker: Customer 3
ops.english: Could I see the wine list? I want a glass of wine.
ops.from: Alla i weld y rhestr win? Dw i moyn gwydraid o win.
ops.note: no change — "Alla i" carries both "can I" and "could I".

after.target_text: Alla i weld y rhestr win? Dw i moyn gwydraid o win.

ops.speaker: Customer
ops.english: That's very kind of you! Yes, I'm on holiday, and I need to practice more to speak Welsh better. Thank you very much, and goodbye.
ops.from: Dych chi'n garedig iawn! Ydw, dw i ar wyliau,… ac ma ishe… i fi ymarfer mwy… i siarad Cymraeg yn well. Diolch yn fawr iawn, a hwyl.
ops.note: no change — only the English spelling of "practise" moved.

after.target_text: Dych chi'n garedig iawn! Ydw, dw i ar wyliau,… ac ma ishe… i fi ymarfer mwy… i siarad Cymraeg yn well. Diolch yn fawr iawn, a hwyl.

ops.speaker: Receptionist
ops.english: Lovely. The room is on the third floor, room 709.
ops.from: Bendigedig. Ma'r stafell ar… y trydydd llawr,… stafell saith cant a naw.
ops.note: no change — 709 is spoken aloud, so it stays "saith cant a naw".

after.target_text: Bendigedig. Ma'r stafell ar… y trydydd llawr,… stafell saith cant a naw.

ops.speaker: Customer
ops.english: Good morning. I'm not feeling great - could you recommend something?
ops.from: Bore da. Dw i ddim yn… teimlo'n dda iawn… — allwch chi argymell rhywbeth?
ops.note: "not feeling very well" → "not feeling great", as on the Northern course.

after.target_text: Bore da. Dw i ddim yn… teimlo'n grêt… — allwch chi argymell rhywbeth?

ops.speaker: Narrator
ops.english: 19. 20. 21. Wednesday. Thursday.
ops.from: Un deg naw. Dau ddeg. Dau ddeg un. Dydd Mercher. Dydd Iau.
ops.note: no change — numerals in the English, words in the Welsh.

after.target_text: Un deg naw. Dau ddeg. Dau ddeg un. Dydd Mercher. Dydd Iau.

ops.speaker: Driver
ops.english: Yes, of course. It may take some time, there's a lot of traffic at the moment.
ops.from: Galla, wrth gwrs. Falle bydd hi'n cymryd… tipyn o amser —… ma lot o draffig… ar hyn o bryd.
ops.note: the English dash became a comma, so the Welsh dash follows it; "ma 'na lot" restores the existential the corpus uses elsewhere.

after.target_text: Galla, wrth gwrs. Falle bydd hi'n cymryd… tipyn o amser,… ma 'na lot o draffig… ar hyn o bryd.

ops.speaker: Driver
ops.english: Here we are. That's twelve pound fifty.
ops.from: Dyma ni. Deuddeg punt a hanner yw hi.
ops.note: no change — "twelve pounds fifty" → "twelve pound fifty" is the same amount, and "punt a hanner" is how it is said.

after.target_text: Dyma ni. Deuddeg punt a hanner yw hi.

ops.speaker: Driver
ops.english: Yes, of course. The machine is just here.
ops.from: Gallwch, wrth gwrs. Ma'r peiriant reit fan hyn.
ops.note: "right here" → "just here": "reit" becomes "jyst", the corpus's Southern word.

after.target_text: Gallwch, wrth gwrs. Ma'r peiriant… jyst fan hyn.

ops.speaker: Narrator
ops.english: 100. 200. 1000. Sunday. 12 o'clock.
ops.from: Cant. Dau gant. Mil. Dydd Sul. Deuddeg o'r gloch.
ops.note: no change — numerals in the English, words in the Welsh.

after.target_text: Cant. Dau gant. Mil. Dydd Sul. Deuddeg o'r gloch.

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: How much is that?

after.target_text: Faint yw hwnna?

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: Can you tell me how much that is?

after.target_text: Allwch chi weud wrtha i… faint yw hwnna?

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: How much does it cost to get a taxi into town?

after.target_text: Faint ma'n gostio… i gael tacsi i'r dre?

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: How much does it cost to get a bus into town?

after.target_text: Faint ma'n gostio… i gael bws i'r dre?

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: Where can we get a bus?

after.target_text: Ble allwn ni gael bws?

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: Where can we get a taxi?

after.target_text: Ble allwn ni gael tacsi?

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: Four single tickets to town, please.

after.target_text: Pedwar tocyn unffordd i'r dre,… os gwelwch yn dda.

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: Two return tickets to town, please.

after.target_text: Dau docyn dwyffordd i'r dre,… os gwelwch yn dda.

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: I prefer to try to speak your language, I think it's polite.

after.target_text: Mae'n well 'da fi drio siarad… eich iaith chi,… dw i'n meddwl bod hynny'n gwrtais.

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: I'm sorry I can't speak very quickly.

after.target_text: Mae'n ddrwg 'da fi… alla i ddim siarad… yn gyflym iawn.

ops.speaker: Narrator
ops.from: Can mil. Chwe deg. Saith deg. Un o'r gloch. Un ar ddeg o'r gloch.
ops.note: no change — the numerals moved, the Welsh words did not.

after.target_text: Can mil. Chwe deg. Saith deg. Un o'r gloch. Un ar ddeg o'r gloch.

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: But if you can speak slowly I think we'll be able to manage.

after.target_text: Ond os allwch chi siarad… yn araf,… dw i'n meddwl… y byddwn ni'n gallu ymdopi.

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: You spoke a little too quickly, so I'm not sure if I understood.

after.target_text: Fe wnaethoch chi siarad… ychydig bach yn rhy gyflym,… felly dw i ddim yn siŵr… os wnes i ddeall.

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: Can we try again?

after.target_text: Allwn ni drio 'to?

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: Can we see the menu?

after.target_text: Allwn ni weld y fwydlen?

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: Can we see the dessert menu also?

after.target_text: Allwn ni weld… y fwydlen bwdin hefyd?

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: Do you have anything to eat?

after.target_text: Oes rhywbeth i'w fwyta 'da chi?

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: Can we pay?

after.target_text: Allwn ni dalu?

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: Can we pay by card?

after.target_text: Allwn ni dalu gyda cherdyn?

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: No, we only take cash.

after.target_text: Na,… dim ond arian parod… ry'n ni'n ei gymryd.

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: I'm sorry, I don't have any cash.

after.target_text: Mae'n ddrwg 'da fi,… does dim arian parod 'da fi.

ops.speaker: Narrator
ops.english: A million. 80. 90. 2 o'clock. 10 o'clock.

after.target_text: Miliwn. Wyth deg. Naw deg. Dau o'r gloch. Deg o'r gloch.

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: Is there a cash machine near here?

after.target_text: Oes 'na beiriant arian… yn agos 'ma?

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: Do you want to pay by cash or card or put it on the room?

after.target_text: Ydych chi moyn talu… gydag arian parod neu gerdyn,… neu ei roi e ar y stafell?

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: Can we put it on the room, please?

after.target_text: Allwn ni ei roi e ar y stafell,… os gwelwch yn dda?

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: Would you like to pay by cash or card or on the room?

after.target_text: Licech chi dalu… gydag arian parod neu gerdyn,… neu ar y stafell?

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: Did you want to pay by cash or card?

after.target_text: Oeddech chi moyn talu… gydag arian parod neu gerdyn?

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: We'll pay by card again, please.

after.target_text: Fe dalwn ni gyda cherdyn 'to,… os gwelwch yn dda.

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: It's hot today, again.

after.target_text: Ma hi'n dwym heddiw, 'to.

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: Is the water warm?

after.target_text: Ydy'r dŵr yn gynnes?

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: No, it's a little cold today.

after.target_text: Nac ydy,… ma hi ychydig bach yn oer heddiw.

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: It's not bad.

after.target_text: Dyw e ddim yn ddrwg.

ops.speaker: Narrator
ops.english: 3 o'clock. 9 o'clock. January. February.

after.target_text: Tri o'r gloch. Naw o'r gloch. Ionawr. Chwefror.

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: That's a bad idea.

after.target_text: Ma hwnna'n syniad drwg.

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: Do you have any orange juice?

after.target_text: Oes sudd oren 'da chi?

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: Do you have any apple juice?

after.target_text: Oes sudd afal 'da chi?

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: Does the boat leave from here?

after.target_text: Ydy'r cwch yn gadael o fan hyn?

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: Does the bus leave from here?

after.target_text: Ydy'r bws yn gadael o fan hyn?

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: Where does the bus leave from?

after.target_text: O ble ma'r bws yn gadael?

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: Is that correct? Am I correct?

after.target_text: Ydy hynny'n gywir? Ydw i'n gywir?

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: Am I wrong about that?

after.target_text: Ydw i'n anghywir am hynny?

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: I'm sorry, my son lost his ticket.

after.target_text: Mae'n ddrwg 'da fi,… ma fy mab i… wedi colli ei docyn.

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: We have paid, but my daughter has lost her ticket.

after.target_text: Ry'n ni wedi talu,… ond ma fy merch i… wedi colli ei thocyn.

ops.speaker: Narrator
ops.english: 4 o'clock. 8 o'clock. March. April.

after.target_text: Pedwar o'r gloch. Wyth o'r gloch. Mawrth. Ebrill.

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: That makes me happy.

after.target_text: Ma hynny'n fy ngwneud i'n hapus.

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: That makes me feel a little worried.

after.target_text: Ma hynny'n gwneud i fi deimlo… ychydig bach yn bryderus.

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: When you talk quickly, it makes me feel stupid.

after.target_text: Pan dych chi'n siarad… yn gyflym,… ma fe'n gwneud i fi… deimlo'n dwp.

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: Is it okay if I sit here?

after.target_text: Ydy hi'n iawn… os dw i'n eistedd fan hyn?

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: Is it okay if we put this here?

after.target_text: Ydy hi'n iawn… os ry'n ni'n rhoi hwn fan hyn?

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: I don't want to be late.

after.target_text: Dw i ddim moyn bod yn hwyr.

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: Are we going to be late?

after.target_text: Ydyn ni'n mynd i fod yn hwyr?

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: I promise I won't be late.

after.target_text: Dw i'n addo… fydda i ddim yn hwyr.

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: I promise we won't be late.

after.target_text: Dw i'n addo… fyddwn ni ddim yn hwyr.

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: I'd like two scoops of ice-cream, please.

after.target_text: Licen i ddau sgŵp o hufen iâ,… os gwelwch yn dda.

ops.speaker: Narrator
ops.english: 5 o'clock. 7 o'clock. May. June.

after.target_text: Pump o'r gloch. Saith o'r gloch. Mai. Mehefin.

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: Can I have one scoop of chocolate and one of strawberry?

after.target_text: Alla i gael un sgŵp o siocled… ac un o fefus?

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: And then another cone with one scoop of lemon and one of blueberry.

after.target_text: A wedyn côn arall… gydag un sgŵp o lemon… ac un o lus.

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: Do you have any ice-cream?

after.target_text: Oes hufen iâ 'da chi?

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: Thank you for all your work.

after.target_text: Diolch am eich holl waith chi.

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: I wish you good luck with everything.

after.target_text: Dw i'n dymuno pob lwc i chi… gyda phopeth.

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: Thank you for helping me.

after.target_text: Diolch am fy helpu i.

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: Good luck with that!

after.target_text: Pob lwc gyda hynny!

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: That's very kind of you.

after.target_text: Ma hynny'n garedig iawn.

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: You're very kind.

after.target_text: Dych chi'n garedig iawn.

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: Thank you for being so friendly.

after.target_text: Diolch am fod mor gyfeillgar.

ops.speaker: Narrator
ops.english: 6 o'clock. July. August. September.

after.target_text: Chwech o'r gloch. Gorffennaf. Awst. Medi.

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: It sounds as though we need to leave soon.

after.target_text: Ma hynny'n swnio fel… bod angen i ni adael… yn fuan.

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: It sounds as though you want us not to do that.

after.target_text: Ma hynny'n swnio fel… dych chi moyn i ni… beidio gwneud hynny.

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: Is there a toilet here?

after.target_text: Oes 'na dŷ bach 'ma?

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: Can you tell me where the toilet is?

after.target_text: Allwch chi weud wrtha i… ble ma'r tŷ bach?

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: It's down there on the left.

after.target_text: Ma fe lawr fan'na… ar y chwith.

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: It's down there on the right.

after.target_text: Ma fe lawr fan'na… ar y dde.

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: Can you say that again?

after.target_text: Allwch chi weud 'na 'to?

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: Yes, I said it's over there.

after.target_text: Galla,… fe ddwedes i… ei fod e draw fan'na.

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: What is that?

after.target_text: Beth yw hwnna?

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: What is that over there?

after.target_text: Beth yw hwnna draw fan'na?

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: Would you like to order some drinks?

after.target_text: Licech chi archebu… rhyw ddiodydd?

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: Do you want to order some drinks first?

after.target_text: Ydych chi moyn archebu… rhyw ddiodydd yn gyntaf?

ops.speaker: Learner
ops.english: Did you want something to drink first?

after.target_text: Oeddech chi moyn rhywbeth… i'w yfed yn gyntaf?

ops.speaker: Narrator
ops.english: October. November. December.

after.target_text: Hydref. Tachwedd. Rhagfyr.
